comments.text:
fun fact: Seychelles plays a major role in shaping Malaysian national anthem.

"Negaraku", my country national anthem, can be traced to a French song titled "La Rosalie" that was famous in the street of Mahé back then.

there was this guy, JWW Birch, during British colonial rule in Malaya (Malaysia before 1957). he was murdered in 1875. a war broke out. the British then exiled a group of people responsible, led by Sultan Abdullah, to Seychelles.

after considerable years, his sons, Raja Chulan and Raja Mansur, were allowed to return. they brought La Rosalie melody and add new lyric. the song was first used as the state anthem before being upgraded as the national anthem in 1957.

to Mahé, I want to say merci beaucoup to the history we shared!
